gaps.term: commutation of pointwise gates with frames
gaps.quote: A pointwise gate commutes with a common frame
gaps.note: The page asserts G(D_v g_1,...) = D_v G(g_1,...) for any invertible linear frame, but a general linear operator on arrays does not commute with a pointwise combination of values. The page never states the property of frames (for example, acting only on addresses) that would make this hold, so the cancellation of intermediate frames cannot be checked.

gaps.note: This cited claim carries the page's central property, that the network restores every auxiliary value, but the page does not say what is undone, how the signs and permutation are reversed, or how the auxiliary roles are restored, so the reader cannot tell what the citation establishes or why it applies here.
